compiled_state.title: [GREEN] Implement plugins/dso/scripts/bug-classification-stats.sh
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: GREEN

Implement bug-classification-stats.sh. Make T1 tests pass.

## Behavior
- Accept --window-days N (default: value from dso-config.conf bug_classification.retro_window_days key, fallback 60)
- Run: ticket list --type=bug --status=closed | parse tags
- For each bug ticket's tags array, collect items matching bug-type-* pattern
- Count by slug (strip bug-type- prefix)
- Output: sorted lines '<count> <slug>' descending by count
- Report uncategorized separately: 'uncategorized: <N>'
- Report classifier-failed separately: 'classifier-failed: <N>' (count tickets with any bug-type-classifier-failed-* tag)
- Consume slug list from bug-classification-registry.json (not markdown)
- Respect TICKET_CMD env var

## Done when
bash tests/scripts/test-bug-classification-stats.sh exits 0.
